question: Next Google Gemini Pro Model released on...?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the calendar date (ET) on which Google's next Gemini Pro model is made available to the general public.

Any Gemini model released after market creation and labeled as "Pro" may qualify (e.g., gemini-3.2-pro, gemini-3.5-pro, or gemini-4.0-pro-preview). Gemini models labeled only as Flash, Flash-Lite, or another non-Pro variant will not qualify.

Products labeled as a GA promotion of an already-existing Preview model (e.g., gemini-3.1-pro-ga) may qualify.

A qualifying model must be launched and publicly accessible, including via open beta or open rolling waitlist signups. A closed beta or any form of private access will not suffice. The release must be either clearly defined and publicly announced by Google as being accessible to the general public or otherwise made publicly accessible and explicitly labeled within the company's official website. Labeling errors, placeholder text, or version names displayed on the website that do not correspond to a model that is actually accessible to the general public will not qualify.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Google, with additional verification from a consensus of credible reporting.

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
Everything below uses only information published on or before 2026-08-12. I left out search results dated after that.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question has no URL. The deciding source is official Google material: the Gemini blog, the Gemini API models list at ai.google.dev, and the DeepMind Gemini model page, checked against credible reporting. The question looks like it mirrors a Polymarket "Next Google Gemini Pro Model released on...?" market created around 2026-07-29. [mirror](https://polymarkets.co.il/es/market/next-google-gemini-pro-model-released-onptptpt-20260729182045875/)
- 2026-08-10: Google DeepMind's Gemini page still labeled Gemini 3.5 Pro "coming soon." Google had published no general-availability timing, API pricing or model card for it. [Let's Data Science](https://letsdatascience.com/news/google-reportedly-shelves-gemini-35-pro-daa76666)
- The latest Pro model on the API is gemini-3.1-pro-preview, released 2026-02-19. I found no stable (GA) release of 3.1 Pro. A GA promotion of 3.1 Pro would also count under the rules. [Google AI docs](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.1-pro-preview)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-08-12, Google had not released any new Pro model to the public. Nothing settles the question yet.
- Gemini 3.5 Pro is officially in partner testing, with no date given.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-12: Made by Google event in NYC, keynote at 3 p.m. PT / 6 p.m. ET, for the Pixel 11 phones and Pixel Watch 5. On-device Gemini is expected to be a theme. I found no confirmed plan for a Pro model announcement. [HotHardware](https://hothardware.com/news/google-pixel-11-launch-event-set-for-august-12-what-to-expect), [PhoneArena](https://www.phonearena.com/news/made-by-google-2026-how-to-watch-and-what-to-expect_id182432)
- 2026-08-10: An RSS report claimed Google had shelved 3.5 Pro in favor of Gemini 4. Nobody confirmed it, and Google's page still said "coming soon." [Let's Data Science](https://letsdatascience.com/news/google-reportedly-shelves-gemini-35-pro-daa76666)
- 2026-08-04: NPowerUser reported a leaked, unconfirmed launch date of August 12 for 3.5 Pro. It cited community buzz, unnamed models on LM Arena and enterprise testing, and named no specific source. [NPowerUser](https://nokiapoweruser.com/gemini-3-5-pro-launch-date-leaked-august-12/)
- 2026-07-28: Geeky Gadgets called the delay indefinite. It said Google had shifted its focus to Gemini 3.6 Flash and that Gemini 4 is in pre-training. [Geeky Gadgets](https://www.geeky-gadgets.com/gemini-3-5-pro-delay/)
- 2026-07-21: Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite, plus 3.5 Flash Cyber as a limited pilot. Google said 3.5 Pro is "testing with partners" and will be broadly available "as soon as it's ready." It also said Gemini 4 pre-training had begun. [DataNorth](https://datanorth.ai/news/google-releases-gemini-3-6-flash), [Let's Data Science](https://letsdatascience.com/news/google-reportedly-shelves-gemini-35-pro-daa76666)
- 2026-07-18: Citing Bloomberg (10 current and former employees), Android Headlines reported that 3.5 Pro missed Pichai's June target because of coding shortfalls. A training-data reset in late June also gave disappointing results. Testing continues with corporate partners and the US government. [Android Headlines](https://www.androidheadlines.com/2026/07/google-gemini-3-5-pro-model-delayed-coding-issues.html)
- 2026-07-16: Bloomberg and CNBC reported 3.5 Pro was "months behind schedule." An Alphabet spokesperson confirmed partner testing. [Let's Data Science](https://letsdatascience.com/news/alphabet-delays-gemini-35-pro-stock-retreats-74e2f3d5)
- An earlier Business Insider report said the release had been pushed to July. A July 13 Tech Times piece said the target was July 17, which passed with no launch. [Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/headlines/the-release-date-for-googles-goog-gemini-35-pro-model-has-been-pushed-to-july-business-insider-reports), [Tech Times](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/320308/20260713/gemini-35-pro-targets-july-17-after-full-rebuild-every-spec-remains-unconfirmed.htm)
- 2026-05-19: At I/O, Google introduced the Gemini 3.5 family, and Pichai said 3.5 Pro would roll out in June.

## 4. Base rates
Past Pro releases, from my background knowledge plus sources:
- 2.5 Pro experimental: 2025-03-25. Preview updates: May 6 and June 5, 2025. GA: 2025-06-17.
- 3 Pro preview: 2025-11-18.
- 3.1 Pro preview: 2026-02-19. [GitHub changelog](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-02-19-gemini-3-1-pro-is-now-in-public-preview-in-github-copilot/)

What this suggests:
- New Pro versions have come roughly every 3 to 4 months. By August 12 it had been almost 6 months since 3.1 Pro, which is longer than usual.
- 3.5 Pro has already missed at least two reported targets (June and July 17).
- Recent Google model launches mostly fell on Tuesdays through Thursdays. Among the answer options, August 18, 25 and 26 are Tuesday or Wednesday. August 14 is a Friday, August 24 and 31 are Mondays.

## 5. Other forecasts
- The Polymarket market and its mirrors exist, with August 6 and August 7 also run as separate date markets. A mirror showed about a 10% implied chance of release by August 7, snapshot date unknown. [orrery](https://orrery.me/markets/will-the-next-google-gemini-pro-model-be-released-on-august-6-2026-20260729182045881)
- Another mirror reportedly showed a related "released by" market favoring "by August 31" at 55 to 62%, also with unknown snapshot dates. [polymarkets.co.il](https://polymarkets.co.il/bn/market/next-google-gemini-pro-model-released-byptptpt/)
- I could not find reliable prices for this specific market as of 2026-08-11 or 2026-08-12. Check Polymarket directly.
- I found no Kalshi, Manifold or expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (Aug 31)
- 2026-08-12, 6 p.m. ET: the Made by Google keynote. A Pro launch there is possible but unconfirmed. Note that the August 12 "leak" points to the same day.
- Further Flash releases or a Gemini 4 announcement could replace or push back 3.5 Pro. The shelving rumor is unconfirmed.
- A GA promotion of 3.1 Pro would qualify, but I saw no signs that one was coming.
- Things to watch: Google's blog and developer changelog, the AI Studio model list, and whether the DeepMind "coming soon" label changes.
